notes:
### Embedded dashboard window (UX)

"Open Dashboard" now opens the dashboard in a Tauri-managed window instead of your default browser — native chrome, no localhost address bar, looks like a real desktop app. External links route to the OS default browser via an on_navigation interceptor; local URLs stay inside the embedded webview. Re-clicking reveals the existing window (no duplicates). Closing the dashboard leaves the tray app alive.

### Updater UX — interrupted-upgrade banner

If you cancelled an upgrade at the UAC prompt or aborted the installer, v1.0.15 silently said "up to date" on the next launch. v1.0.16 writes a pending-update marker before invoking the installer; on next launch it compares against the running version and surfaces a banner so you know to retry.

### Legal pack (DRAFT)

New first-launch consent gate with three required checkboxes (Terms / Privacy / Risk Disclosure). The docs are clearly labelled DRAFT — final language is in counsel review. Sidebar footer adds Privacy / Terms / Risk links.

### Crash telemetry (opt-in, default OFF)

New "Send anonymous crash reports" toggle in tray Settings. Python-side Sentry init with a privacy-first config that scrubs creds / tokens / API keys, drops request headers + cookies, and never collects IPs.

### Installer (P0 fix)

Hardened the NSIS pre-install kill sequence so auto-update no longer hits "Error opening file for writing: tradespace.exe" — three taskkill passes (parent first) with growing waits + final 2s settle.
